name: docs.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  docs.scss — view-docs scoped styles: portal layout (header stamp, GL
//  thread backdrop, persistent 3D architecture scene, treeview, editable
//  crumbs, folder grid, file viewer), GitHub-style markdown + parsed-JSON
//  surfaces, the generated folder SVG glyphs, and the @media print +
//  protected copy-guard surface. The content column extends %MAXAREA so
//  the portal respects the project's responsive grid gutters.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../core/sass/base/variables';
@import '../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../core/sass/base/placeholders';

$_B_DOCS: 'docs';

.#{$_B_DOCS} {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
  line-height: 1.6;
  padding-top: to-rem($space-5xl);
  box-sizing: border-box;

  // ── GL thread backdrop + persistent 3D architecture scene ────────────
  // Both are fixed, viewport-sized layers behind the content column —
  // the scene stays mounted on every docs page so folder navigation is
  // always available (orbit/pinch on exposed areas, tap-to-pick).
  &-gl,
  &-scene {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    z-index: 0;
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }

  &-gl {
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  // The scene needs pointer events where the content column leaves it
  // exposed — OrbitControls owns rotate/pinch, taps pick nodes. Ink is
  // the project turquoise accent so the structure reads as the site's
  // signature color, and stays subtle against the content surfaces.
  &-scene {
    color: var(--color-accent);
    cursor: grab;

    &:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }
  }

  // CSS fallback: soft drifting gradient band when WebGL is off.
  &-gl-fallback &-gl {
    background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 30%, currentColor 45%, transparent 60%);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    opacity: 0.04;
    animation: #{$_B_DOCS}-drift 18s linear infinite;
  }

  @keyframes #{$_B_DOCS}-drift {
    from {
      background-position: 0% 0%;
    }
    to {
      background-position: 100% 100%;
    }
  }

  // ── Content column — the project's max-area gutter contract ──────────
  // The containers themselves are pointer-transparent so the fixed scene
  // behind stays draggable wherever no interactive surface covers it;
  // interactive children re-enable hit-testing explicitly.
  &-header,
  &-crumbs,
  &-body,
  &-main,
  &-grid {
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  &-header,
  &-body {
    @extend %MAXAREA;

    z-index: 1;
  }

  &-header {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-md);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-md);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 88%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }

  &-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 100;
    font-size: to-rem($space-3xl);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  &-updated {
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    opacity: 0.6;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  &-body {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: to-rem($space-xl);
    flex: 1;

    @include layout-1024() {
      grid-template-columns: to-rem($space-7xl) 1fr;
      align-items: start;
    }
  }

  // ── Treeview — collapsible panel under a toggle on mobile/tablet ─────
  &-nav-toggle {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    pointer-events: auto;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    text-align: left;
    color: inherit;
    border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-md);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
    user-select: text;

    &::before {
      content: '▸ ';
    }

    &[aria-expanded='true']::before {
      content: '▾ ';
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      outline: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
      outline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  &-nav {
    pointer-events: auto;
    display: none;
    max-height: 70vh;
    overflow: auto;
    // Translucent surface + blur — the fixed scene backdrop stays visible
    // around the edges without fighting the tree text for contrast.
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 92%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);

    .#{$_B_DOCS}-nav-open & {
      display: block;
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      display: block;
      position: sticky;
      top: to-rem($space-xl);
    }
  }

  &-tree {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);

    @include layout-960() {
      font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
    }

    ul {
      list-style: none;
      padding-left: to-rem($space-md);
      margin: 0;
    }
  }

  &-tree-item {
    background: none;
    border: 0;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-align: left;
    // ≥34px row + side padding — a comfortable tap target on touch.
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-2xs);
    width: 100%;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    opacity: 0.85;
    user-select: text;

    &[aria-current='page'],
    &:focus-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      outline: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
      outline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    }
  }

  // ── Editable breadcrumbs ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-crumbs {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-md);
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-md);
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 88%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }

  &-crumb {
    pointer-events: auto;
    background: none;
    border: 0;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-2xs);
    opacity: 0.75;
    user-select: text;

    &::after {
      content: ' /';
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      outline: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    }
  }

  &-crumb-edit {
    pointer-events: auto;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: to-rem($space-4xl);
    background: transparent;
    border: to-rem($space-3xs) dashed currentColor;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    padding: to-rem($space-3xs) to-rem($space-2xs);
    opacity: 0.6;

    &:focus {
      opacity: 1;
      border-style: solid;
      outline: none;
    }
  }

  // ── Folder/file grid with generated glyphs ────────────────────────────
  &-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(to-rem($space-5xl), 1fr));
    gap: to-rem($space-md);
  }

  &-card {
    pointer-events: auto;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 90%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid transparent;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
    padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-sm);
    transition: border-color 0.4s ease;

    &:focus-visible,
    &:hover {
      border-color: currentColor;
      outline: none;
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      outline: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
      outline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
    }
  }

  &-card-art {
    width: to-rem($space-4xl);
    height: to-rem($space-3xl);
    display: block;
  }

  &-card-label {
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    word-break: break-word;
    text-align: center;
  }

  // Generated folder glyph — strokes follow the theme ink.
  &-folder {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: visible;
  }

  &-folder-body {
    fill: none;
    stroke: currentColor;
    stroke-width: 1.5;
  }

  &-folder-thread {
    fill: none;
    stroke: currentColor;
    stroke-width: 0.6;
    opacity: 0.55;
  }

  // ── File viewer — translucent reading surface over the scene ─────────
  &-viewer {
    pointer-events: auto;
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
    padding: to-rem($space-md);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 93%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }

  &-viewer-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-sm);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
  }

  &-viewer-back {
    background: none;
    border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    min-height: to-rem($space-2xl);
  }

  &-viewer-path {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    opacity: 0.7;
    word-break: break-all;
  }

  // ── Rendered content — markdown, JSON trees, sanitized html reports ──
  &-content {
    overflow: auto;
    max-width: 100%;

    // Generic element styling shared by .docs-md and .docs-html payloads —
    // sanitized reports inherit the project surface instead of shipping
    // raw unstyled markup.
    .docs-md,
    .docs-html {
      max-width: 75ch;
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);

      @include layout-960() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      h1,
      h2 {
        border-bottom: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xs);
        font-weight: 200;
      }

      h3,
      h4,
      h5,
      h6 {
        font-weight: 300;
      }

      a {
        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-underline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
      }

      code {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 0.9em;
        background: var(--bg-secondary);
        padding: to-rem($space-3xs) to-rem($space-2xs);
        border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
      }

      pre {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
        line-height: 1.5;
        padding: to-rem($space-md);
        overflow: auto;
        background: var(--bg-secondary);
        border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);

        code {
          background: none;
          padding: 0;
        }
      }

      table {
        border-collapse: collapse;
        width: 100%;
        font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
        display: block;
        overflow-x: auto;

        th,
        td {
          border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
          padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);
          text-align: left;
        }

        th {
          background: var(--bg-secondary);
        }

        tr:nth-child(even) td {
          background: var(--bg-secondary);
        }
      }

      blockquote {
        border-left: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        margin: to-rem($space-sm) 0;
        padding-left: to-rem($space-md);
        opacity: 0.8;
      }

      ul,
      ol {
        padding-left: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      hr {
        border: 0;
        border-top: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        opacity: 0.4;
        margin: to-rem($space-lg) 0;
      }

      img {
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
      }
    }

    // Parsed JSON surface — real numbers, key/field rows and tables.
    .docs-json {
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
      max-width: 75ch;

      @include layout-960() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      .docs-json-obj {
        margin: 0;
      }

      .docs-json-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(to-rem($space-6xl), auto) 1fr;
        gap: to-rem($space-md);
        padding: to-rem($space-3xs) 0;
        border-bottom: to-rem($space-3xs) dotted color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent);
        align-items: baseline;

        > dt {
          font-family: var(--font-mono);
          font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
          color: var(--text-secondary);
          overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        }

        > dd {
          margin: 0;
          min-width: 0;
          overflow-x: auto;
        }

        // Nested groups indent under their key.
        > dd .docs-json-obj,
        > dd .docs-json-table,
        > dd .docs-json-list {
          margin: to-rem($space-3xs) 0;
        }
      }

      .docs-json-num {
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        font-weight: 400;
      }

      .docs-json-str {
        color: var(--text-secondary);
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }

      .docs-json-bool,
      .docs-json-null {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        opacity: 0.8;
      }

      .docs-json-table {
        border-collapse: collapse;
        font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
        display: block;
        overflow-x: auto;

        th,
        td {
          border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
          padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);
          text-align: left;
        }

        th {
          background: var(--bg-secondary);
          font-family: var(--font-mono);
        }
      }

      .docs-json-list {
        margin: 0;
        padding-left: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      // Percentage meter — the coverage-summary "real numbers" treatment.
      .docs-json-pct {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }

      .docs-json-pct-bar {
        display: inline-block;
        width: to-rem($space-4xl);
        height: to-rem($space-sm);
        background: var(--bg-secondary);
        border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        vertical-align: middle;

        &::before {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          inset: 0;
          width: calc(var(--docs-json-pct) * 1%);
          background: currentColor;
          opacity: 0.7;
        }
      }

      .docs-json-nest,
      .docs-json-empty,
      .docs-json-more {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        opacity: 0.6;
      }

      .docs-json-link {
        color: inherit;
      }
    }

    // Mermaid diagrams — a themed surface; edge paths get a slow marching
    // dash so flowcharts read as living flows (the "fully animated"
    // contract), tuned subtle like the rest of the backdrop.
    .docs-mermaid {
      padding: to-rem($space-md);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
      overflow-x: auto;
      text-align: center;

      svg {
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
      }

      .edgePath path,
      .flowchart-link,
      .edgePaths .path {
        stroke-dasharray: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-2xs);
        animation: #{$_B_DOCS}-edge-flow 6s linear infinite;
      }

      .node rect,
      .node circle,
      .node polygon,
      .cluster rect {
        transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
      }
    }

    @keyframes #{$_B_DOCS}-edge-flow {
      to {
        stroke-dashoffset: to-rem($space-xl);
      }
    }

    // Readability surface for source/text payloads — the "ts files need a
    // background" contract: theme-aware --bg-secondary on --text-primary.
    .docs-code {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
      line-height: 1.5;
      padding: to-rem($space-md);
      overflow: auto;
      white-space: pre;
      tab-size: 2;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    }
  }

  // ── Architecture scene hidden state ──────────────────────────────────
  &-scene-off {
    display: none;
  }

  // ── Copy protection surface ───────────────────────────────────────────
  &-protected {
    user-select: none;
  }
}

// Mobile GPUs: backdrop blur is expensive — surfaces keep their
// near-opaque translucent bg and drop only the filter (app.scss contract).
@media (max-width: $bk-768) {
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-header,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-crumbs,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-nav,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-card,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-viewer {
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
    backdrop-filter: none;
  }
}

// Print-screen / print exfiltration: the protected region never prints.
@media print {
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-protected,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-viewer {
    display: none;
  }
}
